title: Lost City Svanger
description: A custom loot expansion for The Lost City, integrating Point Blank and First Aid into a balanced scavenging experience.
body:
![Banner Lost city scavenger](https://github.com/pablolondojara9-cpu/LostCityScavengerAssets/blob/main/images/baner.png?raw=true)

## Lost City: Scavenger

## This mod is perfect for your zombies modpack

Lost City: Scavenger is a loot expansion addon that redesigns exploration rewards across supported structures, making every location feel more immersive, logical, and rewarding. Instead of random loot, each structure now contains carefully balanced loot pools based on its purpose. Military locations provide tactical equipment, abandoned buildings contain useful survival supplies, and high-value areas reward players with rare gear while maintaining progression balance. This addon is designed to enhance survival gameplay without overwhelming the player with excessive loot.

![overview](https://github.com/pablolondojara9-cpu/LostCityScavengerAssets/blob/main/images/Overviw.png?raw=true)

## Overview

Current supported structures include:

Current dependencies:

*   Berezka API
*   First Aid
*   GeckoLib
*   LesRaisins Armor
*   Point Blank
*   The Lost City
*   Underground Bunkers

Loot has been manually balanced for each supported structure to create a progression that feels natural during exploration.

Future updates will continue improving balance and expanding compatibility with additional structures and mods.

![Features](https://github.com/pablolondojara9-cpu/LostCityScavengerAssets/blob/main/images/features.png?raw=true)

## Features

✔ Completely redesigned loot tables

✔ Location-based loot generation

✔ Balanced survival progression

✔ Point Blank weapons and ammunition

✔ First Aid medical supplies

✔ LesRaisins Armor equipment

✔ Custom loot for Underground Bunkers

✔ Vanilla-friendly balance philosophy

✔ Carefully adjusted rarity for valuable equipment

![Requerements](https://github.com/pablolondojara9-cpu/LostCityScavengerAssets/blob/main/images/Requerimientos.png?raw=true)

## Requirements

This addon requires the original supported mods to be installed.

Required mods:

*   The Lost City
*   Point Blank
*   Berezka API
*   GeckoLib
*   First Aid
*   LesRaisins Armor
*   Underground Bunkers

This project does **not** include any assets or code from those mods.

All rights belong to their respective authors.

### Important

For the best experience, it is strongly recommended to use a **separate Minecraft instance** for this addon.

Switching between different modpacks or replacing mods inside the same `.minecraft` folder may leave cached data from previous worlds or datapacks, which can affect generated loot tables.

Using a clean game instance helps prevent these issues.

![Credits](https://github.com/pablolondojara9-cpu/LostCityScavengerAssets/blob/main/images/creditos.png?raw=true)

## Credits & Feedback

This project is actively maintained and community feedback is always appreciated.

If you've played Lost City: Scavenger, I'd love to hear your thoughts.

Feedback is especially welcome regarding:

*   Loot balance
*   Structure suggestions
*   Compatibility issues
*   Bugs
*   New mod integrations

Every report helps improve future releases.

Thank you for downloading and supporting the project!
